powers.title: All-Encompassing Nature
powers.description: Your view of nature is broader than most, expanding your knowledge.
rows: Requirement: You must be proficient in Nature.
Trigger: You would make an Arcana, Nature, or Religion check
Effect: You can roll a Nature check instead.

powers.title: Barkskin
powers.description: A protective layer of tree bark covers your body and armor.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a power bonus to AC equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Bear's Strength
powers.description: Primal energy surges through your ally, granting him or her the strength of a wild beast.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* +2 power bonus to damage rolls that include the target's Strength.
* +2 power bonus to Athletics checks and Strength ability checks.
* The target's Strength increases by 4 for the purpose of determining carrying capacity.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Cat's Grace
powers.description: You imbue an ally with the quick reflexes and fast strike of the jungle cat.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* +1 power bonus to Reflex.
* +2 power bonus to initiative checks, Dexterity-based skill checks, and Dexterity ability checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Dust Eddy
powers.description: You surround yourself with a violent swirl of wind that fills the air with dust and debris.
rows: Effect: You gain partial concealment and activate an aura 1 that last until the end of your next turn or until you leave beast form. Any enemy that ends its turn in the aura is blinded until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 63.

powers.title: Elk's Fortitude
powers.description: You imbue an ally with the endurance and steadfast determination of an elk.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* A healing surge.
* +1 power bonus to Fortitude.
* +2 power bonus to Endurance checks and Constitution ability checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Ferocious Transformation
powers.description: In response to an enemy's attack, you transform into a beast and pounce.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits you while you aren't in beast form
Effect: You use wild shape to change into beast form and then shift 1 square. You gain combat advantage against the triggering enemy until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fleet Pursuit
powers.description: Your limbs propel you forward with the speed of a cheetah.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a power bonus to your speed while you are in beast form equal to your Dexterity.

powers.title: Form of the Sprinting Elk
powers.description: Your form shifts as you assume the guise of a great elk and quickly bound away.
rows: Effect: You assume the form of the sprinting elk until you take an extended rest or until you end the form as a free action. While in this form, you gain a +4 bonus to speed, but you cannot attack, manipulate objects, or use any magic item powers. Also, your gear becomes part of the form and is inaccessible.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 79.

powers.title: Lesser Restoration
powers.description: Motes of green energy suffuse your ally, letting him or her draw strength from the essence of the world.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: The target can make a saving throw and spend a healing surge.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 79.

powers.title: Obscuring Mist
powers.description: A thick fog coalesces from nowhere, hiding your allies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of lightly obscured squares that lasts until the end of your next turn.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists, and you can increase its size by 1 to a maximum of burst 5.

powers.title: Resist Energy
powers.description: Magical energy washes around you, but your primal magic protects you and your allies.
rows: Trigger: You take cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains resist 5 to the triggering damage type until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Seed of Healing
powers.description: Primal power threads through you, coalescing into a golden seed ripe with healing magic.
rows: Effect: You spend a healing surge but regain no hit points. Instead, you create a golden seed the size of an acorn. The seed lasts until it is eaten or until the end of your next extended rest. A creature carrying the seed can take a minor action to eat it and regain hit points equal to 10 + your healing surge value.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Skittering Sneak
powers.description: You can adopt the form of a mouse, a large spider, or another animal that wouldn't draw a second glance from most observers.
rows: Prerequisite: You must have the wild shape power.

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can use wild shape to assume the form of a Tiny natural beast or fey beast, such as a mouse, a house cat, or a large spider. In this form, you gain a +5 bonus to Stealth checks. You can't attack, pick up anything, or manipulate objects.

powers.title: Sudden Bite
powers.description: When your foe drops its guard, you change into a beast to strike.
rows: Trigger: An enemy provokes an opportunity attack from you
Effect: You use wild shape to change into beast form. You then make the opportunity attack.

powers.title: Verdant Bounty
powers.description: Plants erupt to hide your allies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a plant-filled zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. The zone is heavily obscured, and you and your allies gain a +5 bonus to Stealth checks while within the zone.

powers.title: Warding Wind
powers.description: Winds howl around you, shielding you from harm and hurling your attacker away.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by a melee attack
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn. If the triggering attack misses you, you slide the attacker 2 squares.

powers.title: Black Harbinger
powers.description: You can turn into a raven and take wing, no longer earthbound.
rows: Prerequisite: You must have the wild shape power.

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can use wild shape to assume the form of a Tiny raven. In this form, you gain a fly speed equal to your speed, and your walking speed becomes 2. You can't attack, pick up anything, or manipulate objects.
Until this power ends, you can use wild shape to change among this form, another beast form, and your humanoid form.

powers.title: Blood Frenzy Howl
powers.description: Observing your allies' ferocity, you let lose a long howl. Your ululation awakens dormant primal spirits to invigorate your allies.
rows: Trigger: An ally in the burst scores a critical hit
Target: Each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution.

powers.title: Camouflage Cloak
powers.description: Your target takes on the appearance of the surrounding terrain, fading from view.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target becomes invisible until he or she moves or until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Chant of Sustenance
powers.description: You intone a brief petition to primal spirits, who funnel power on your behalf to sustain effects you have created.
rows: Target: Each of your zones in the burst
Effect: You move each target 5 squares. If any of those targets will end at the end of your current turn, you can make those targets last until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Creeping Vines
powers.description: Vines erupt along a vertical surface, creating handholds and footholds for you and your allies.
rows: Effect: The wall creates a zone of creeping vines that lasts until the end of your next turn. Each square of the zone must be adjacent to a vertical surface. While within the zone, you and your allies can climb that vertical surface with a climb speed of 5.

powers.title: Eagle's Splendor
powers.description: You invoke primal magic to bestow the majestic presence of the eagle upon you or your ally.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* +1 power bonus to Charisma attack rolls.
* +1 power bonus to Will.
* +2 power bonus to Charisma-based skill checks and Charisma ability checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Leaf Wall
powers.description: Wind spirits hurl tempests of leaves in a swirling mass that disorients enemies while concealing your allies.
rows: Effect: You conjure a leafy wall that lasts until the end of the encounter. The wall can be up to 4 squares high and must be on a solid surface. You or any ally has partial concealment while in the wall. Enemies grant combat advantage while in the wall or adjacent to it.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 101.

powers.title: Meld into Stone
powers.description: Your body merges with stone, letting you slip out of sight and away from harm.
rows: Effect: You shift into an adjacent square occupied by an object made of stone or earth that is your size or larger, such as a wall, a statue, or a boulder. While you occupy this square, you can see normally but you do not have line of effect to anything, and nothing has line of effect to you. You remain in this state until the end of the encounter, until you end this effect as a minor action, or until the object is destroyed. When the effect ends, you appear in the nearest unoccupied square.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Nature's Stride
powers.description: You gain a heightened sense of the world around you, letting you move unhindered.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target gains a +2 power bonus to speed and ignores difficult terrain.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Owl's Wisdom
powers.description: Your primal magic grants your ally the wisdom and insight of an owl, sharpening willpower and granting superior sight.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* Low-light vision.
* +1 power bonus to Will.
* +2 power bonus to Wisdom-based skill checks and Wisdom ability checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Raise the Stones
powers.description: You call to the spirits of earth, and a group of monoliths emerge from the ground.
rows: Effect: You create six stone pillars in unoccupied squares on solid ground in the burst. The pillars are blocking terrain. Each pillar stands 10 feet tall and has AC 5, Fortitude 15, Reflex 5, and 30 hit points. A creature can climb a pillar with a DC 15 Athletics check. If a pillar is reduced to 0 hit points, its square and each square adjacent to it becomes rubble-strewn difficult terrain.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 63.

powers.title: Rebuking Thorns
powers.description: You utter an evocation of protection, which launches thorns at your attackers.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, when any enemy hits you with a melee attack, that enemy takes damage equal to your Constitution or Dexterity.

powers.title: Rodent's Agility
powers.description: In the blink of an eye, you transform into a mouse, dart away from your foe, and then transform back.
rows: Prerequisite: You must have the wild shape power.
Effect: You move 5 squares. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and you can move through enemies' spaces during it.

powers.title: Serpent's Cunning
powers.description: Your ally gains the serpent's cunning, a power that hones his mind to a razor's edge.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target gains the following benefits until the end of his or her next extended rest.
* +1 power bonus to Intelligence attack rolls.
* Proficiency in one skill of the target's choice.
* +2 power bonus to Intelligence-based skill checks and Intelligence ability checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Stalker's Eyes
powers.description: Your eyesight, hearing, and sense of smell grow as strong as those of a predator.
rows: Effect: You gain low-light vision and a +4 bonus to Perception checks until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Swarm Dispersal
powers.description: Your body bursts into a swarm and scatters, making an attack ineffective against you.
rows: Trigger: You take damage from a melee or a ranged attack
Prerequisite: You must have the wild shape power.
Effect: You gain resist 10 to all damage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Treetop Lurker
powers.description: You take the form of a treetop creature or another animal or insect that can easily traverse heights, taking to a perch unseen by your enemies.
rows: Effect: You assume the form of a Tiny or Small beast or insect that can climb to great heights with ease until the end of the encounter, or until you end the effect as a free action. In this form, you gain a climb speed equal to your speed and a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks. Additionally, any time you fall, you treat the distance you fall as being 20 feet shorter for the purposes of determining falling damage. While in this form, you can't attack or use magic items.

powers.title: Animal Shapes
powers.description: You transform yourself and your allies into mice, beetles, or other seemingly innocuous animals.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the targets assume the forms of Tiny creatures, such as mice, cats, beetles, or spiders. While in these forms, the targets can't attack, pick up anything, or manipulate objects. The targets gain a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks and a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex. Each target can end this effect on himself or herself as a minor action.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists on yourself and any target within 5 squares of you.

powers.title: Armor of the Wild
powers.description: Your hide hardens into armored plates. Your enemies can hurt you, but not as badly as they would like.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, while you are in beast form, you gain resistance to all damage equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Bountiful Vigor
powers.description: Calling forth the essence of the primal world, you infuse your ally with the power of life and renewal.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target has regeneration 5 while bloodied.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Cleansing Rain
powers.description: A gentle rain falls over the area around you, soothing burning wounds.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a rainy zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. While within the zone, you and any allies gain resist 10 fire and resist 10 acid and a +2 power bonus to saving throws against ongoing fire damage and ongoing acid damage.

powers.title: Clear the Chaff
powers.description: As primal energy washes over your allies, effects that would hinder them fall away like chaff on the wind.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target can make a saving throw with a +2 power bonus.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Diving Fin
powers.description: You can transform into a small sea creature, using your fins to traverse water as easily as land.
rows: Effect: You assume the form of a Tiny or Small aquatic beast, such as a fish or eel, until the end of the encounter, or until you end the effect as a free action. In this form, you gain a swim speed equal to your speed and you can breathe underwater. While in this form, you can't attack, move on land, or use magic items.

powers.title: Feywild Sojourn
powers.description: You take a jaunt to the Feywild, returning to the world when you have healed and changed form.
rows: Effect: You teleport to a safe place in the Feywild. While you are there, you can't take any actions other than using your second wind and wild shape. At the end of your next turn or as a move action before then, you reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 squares of the space you left.

powers.title: Form of the Hunting Falcon
powers.description: You change into a nimble bird of prey that easily soars out of reach of your foes.
rows: Effect: You assume the form of the hunting falcon until you take an extended rest, or until you end this effect as a free action. While in this form, you are Small, you have a fly speed of 8, and you gain a +5 power bonus to Perception checks. However, you cannot attack, manipulate objects, or use any magic item powers.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 81.

powers.title: Goodberry
powers.description: You infuse mundane berries with primal power, letting those who consume them take advantage of their curative energy.
rows: Effect: You create four goodberries. Each lasts until it is consumed or until the end of your next extended rest. A creature can take a minor action to consume a goodberry either to regain 10 hit points, to make a saving throw, or to gain 10 temporary hit points.
powers.source: Published in Primal Power, page(s) 45, Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 104.

powers.title: Roots of Rescue
powers.description: Roots erupt from the ground and hold your ally in place.
rows: Trigger: You or an ally within 10 squares of you is pulled, pushed, or slid
Target: The character affected by the forced movement
Effect: The target is unaffected by the forced movement.

powers.title: Spirited Wind
powers.description: A powerful gust circles around you and lifts you and an ally into the air.
rows: Target: You and one ally in the burst
Effect: Each target can fly up to 6 squares as a free action, and gains a +4 power bonus to all defenses against opportunity attacks provoked by this movement.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 64.

powers.title: Swarm Swap
powers.description: As an attack sweeps toward you, you burst into a swarm that swoops over an enemy, forcing it into your space.
rows: Trigger: You are targeted by an area or a close attack
Target: One creature
Effect: You swap places with the target.

powers.title: Updraft
powers.description: A gust of wind swirls around you, lifting you into the air.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target flies up to 5 squares.
Sustain Move: The target flies again, or you use the power on a different target.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 81.

powers.title: Winter Storm
powers.description: Ice covers the ground, and biting wind makes your foes more vulnerable to your cold attacks.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of difficult terrain that lasts until the end of your next turn. While within the zone, any enemy gains vulnerable 5 cold. You can end the zone as a minor action.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists, and you can increase its size by 1 to a maximum of burst 5.
